title: Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) Masterclass
description: Scientific digital evidence preservation, chain of custody, Volatility memory analysis, Autopsy disk artifacts, Wireshark network forensics, and court-admissible reporting.
objectives: Master the 5-stage scientific forensic methodology (Preservation, Acquisition, Analysis, Reporting)
Perform RAM memory analysis using Volatility framework to extract malicious process trees
Analyze disk images and file system artifacts (MFT, Registry, Event Logs) using Autopsy
Maintain legally admissible chain of custody and SHA-256 cryptographic hash integrity
